verdict.rationale: Paperspace's docs directly support the story: custom templates let you snapshot a configured machine and reuse it for new machines with your exact specs (paperspace-docs-3, paperspace-docs-25), and the Deployments feature is explicitly a containers-as-a-service that runs your own Docker images (paperspace-docs-8). Root SSH access to VMs (paperspace-docs-12/19/21) further supports building a fully custom environment. missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that custom templates and Docker deployments work smoothly in practice, and more detail on the template-creation workflow beyond a single doc line.
